explication: Elysia is an agentic decision-tree platform: a user query enters through the app’s WebSocket API or Python Tree interface, then the tree chooses actions and streams results. Its built-in capabilities include Weaviate retrieval and aggregation, text tools, visualization, postprocessing, custom tools, collection preprocessing, and per-user configuration. The README documents the product workflow; source excerpts and the SOURCE INDEX support the core call links. Several API routes and tool implementations were not sampled, so their internal connections are omitted or shown as documented capabilities.
